overallNotes: Marisa Cardenas (personal_01) is a richly detailed persona spanning nearly 4 years (Jan 2025 - Oct 2028) of a 38-year-old Pierce County habitat field supervisor in Tacoma, WA. Her arc traces the transformation of a single oyster-habitat pilot into a recurring county restoration program with 5 active shoreline sites. The narrative has strong continuity across work, health, family, and personal life. Key patterns: (1) Professional growth from field supervisor to public-facing program lead — setbacks (state review rejection, storm damage, shoulder injury) are met with structured problem-solving rather than defeat. (2) Chronic shoulder strain and winter depression are managed with increasing self-awareness — initial bracing gives way to consistent maintenance routines. (3) Co-parenting with Daniel evolves from ad-hoc conflict to shared spreadsheets, monthly planning calls, and a custody app — Evan becomes more assertive about boundaries. (4) Key supporting figures are well-defined: Gordon (mentor→retired sounding board), Talia (wetland biologist/technical ally), Nina (practical friend→lecture companion), Rosa (sister/emergency support). (5) Personal interests layer naturally onto existing patterns — maritime history reading leads to waterfront lectures, lunch walks lead to shorebird logging, soccer tournaments lead to food truck exploration and a 90s movie ritual. CRITICAL ISSUE with current metadata: ALL 30 slices have emotional_tone:'neutral' which is clearly incorrect — emotional tones vary widely (positive for personal discoveries, negative for setbacks, mixed for most work milestones). Tags are identical generic categories (work/family/health/finance/etc.) applied indiscriminately — these derive from regex extraction and provide zero retrieval value. Nearly all summary fields are literal quotes from the user's first turn rather than genuine summaries of the conversation content. The decisions field is generally well-maintained and captures key outcomes accurately.
